reviews.title: Comfortable, Clear, and Perfect for Gaming 🎧🔥
reviews.comment:
This headset has been great so far 🙌 The sound is clear and immersive, whether I’m gaming, watching videos, or chatting. The wireless connection is smooth and reliable, and switching between modes is super easy.
It’s lightweight and comfortable enough for long sessions without feeling tight or heavy, which makes a big difference. The mic sounds clear, and the overall build feels solid and high quality.
Great performance, great comfort, and definitely worth it for a gaming setup. Highly recommend!

reviews.title: Quite literally the worst headphones I have ever had the misfortune of purchasing.
reviews.comment:
Putting a 5 star review so this gets seen. The sound quality on these things are straight ass. The "Surround 2.1" and "THX Audio" they come with are absolutely horrendous, and a quick google search will tell you that Razer has neglected to properly address the issues with these headphones for nearly two years now. These were my real first pair of wireless headphones because I wanted something a bit more versatile while gaming and watching movies, and I cannot go a single session without hearing some horrendous sound distortion.
Playing Overwatch with these has been an absolute nightmare and the equalizer that is included with the app is absolute garbage. My previous headphones were some 80 dollar Sennheisers that literally get the job done better than these things. Do NOT buy these. Save your money and stay the hell away from Razer. They should be ashamed of themselves.
